maddeler.e:
نتصبصب (form IIq)
# نَتَصَبْصَبُ (nataṣabṣabu) /na.ta.sˤab.sˤa.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَصَبْصَبَ (taṣabṣaba)
# نَتَصَبْصَبَ (nataṣabṣaba) /na.ta.sˤab.sˤa.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَصَبْصَبَ (taṣabṣaba)
# نَتَصَبْصَبْ (nataṣabṣab) /na.ta.sˤab.sˤab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَصَبْصَبَ (taṣabṣaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
